translations.text: God, always guard your Church with your loving favor, so that, renewed through the paschal mysteries, she may reach the radiance of the resurrection. Through Christ our Lord. R. Amen.

translations.text: Almighty and everlasting God, be present to the sacraments of your great compassion, and send forth the spirit of adoption to give new birth to the new peoples whom the baptismal font bears for you, so that what our humble ministry is to carry out may be fulfilled by the working of your power. Through Christ our Lord. R. Amen.

translations.text: God, through your Son you have bestowed the fire of your radiance upon the faithful. Sanctify this new fire, and grant that through these paschal feasts we may be so inflamed with heavenly desires that, with pure minds, we may reach the feasts of everlasting radiance. Through Christ our Lord. R. Amen.
